overall: 10 of 14 rows confirmed, 2 discrepancies, 2 failed, none blocked. All Tier 1 ndlegis script routes work and generalise, including decimal titles and chapters. Problems: (1) LII admin-code slugs drop the leading zero of decimal chapters (03.2 -> 3.2), so 'verbatim' URLs silently return a title list. (2) The State Library ND Reports volumes stop at v50: v51-79 return 404, including v79, which the record wrongly lists as confirmed. (3) The ndcourts opinion and docket probes are gated (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED) and cannot confirm. (4) Session laws go back to 1991, and older years have only full-book PDFs. Regex misses: ND court style 'section 28-32-46, N.D.C.C.' and 'Section 20 of Article I of the North Dakota Constitution'. Federal (N.D. Ill.) cites route correctly.
